errors.evidence: The description swaps the final values for the AU and TU lines. At a decoding temperature of 0.8, the figure shows the TU (blue) line ending at the higher value (approx. 0.185) and the AU (red) line ending at a slightly lower value (approx. 0.183). The description incorrectly reverses these values.
The description fails to mention the legend located in the top-left corner, which identifies the three data series by color.
